Spacecraft name ROSIsat (Radiation Orbital Shielding Investigation Satellite)
Type CubeSat

Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters US
Oneliner

Shield onboard flight computer memory modules from space radiation using various materials and substances
Description

ROSIsat will be the first student-built satellite for Embry-Riddle’s Daytona Beach campus.

ROSIsat's main research mission is to shield onboard flight computer memory modules from space radiation using various materials and substances, including simulated Martian and Lunar regolith.

Some of the primary components of ROSIsat are being designed and integrated in-house, including the Radiation Shielding Experiment payload and Magnetorquer
